topic: From Circles to Heat: The Magic of Fourier Series

sections.title: Prerequisite Intuition: The Epicycle Analogy
lecture_lines: Any periodic motion uses simple circles.
One gear rotates on another gear.
animations: Draw a central rotating vector at the origin, color #FFFFFF.
Add a second rotating vector attached to the first, color #FF8000.
Trace the path of the combined vector tip in #00FFFF.
Display the epicycle path decomposing into separate components, color #FFFFFF.
Highlight the final Fourier series components at the bottom, color #FFFF00.

sections.title: Mathematical Foundation: Decomposing Signals
lecture_lines: Complex waves are made of sines.
animations: Display a complex periodic signal graph in #FFFFFF.
Decompose the signal into three distinct sine waves, colors #FF0000, #00FF00, #0000FF.
Show the summation back into the original signal in #FFFFFF.

sections.title: The Heat Equation Bridge
lecture_lines: Heat spreads in a metal rod.
animations: Visualize a 1D heat distribution bar, color #FF8000 (hot) to #0000FF (cold).
Overlay the Fourier series expansion components on the bar, color #FFFFFF.
Show the evolution of heat diffusion over time, color transition #FF0000 to #00FFFF.
Animate high-frequency components decaying faster than low-frequency, color #FFFF00.
Display the final equilibrium state as a flat line in #00FF00.

sections.title: Synthesis: Circular Representation to Thermal Equilibrium
animations: Animate epicycles mapping to temperature peaks, colors #FFFFFF and #FF8000.
Morph circular motion into a spreading heat distribution plot, color #FFFF00.
Highlight the equilibrium state where heat becomes uniform, color #00FF00.

sections.title: Conclusion and Summary
animations: Display a summary list of the key concepts, color #FFFFFF.
Highlight the bridge between epicycles and heat diffusion, color #FF0000.
Fade out all elements to show a final concluding text in #00FFFF.
